content:
anya (product): Heads-up: steering committee asked for a concrete acceptance checklist for the new "dynamic cost profiles" workstream. Need owners and deliverables across SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing. Can we do a quick owners sync here?
leo (eng-runtime): I can own runtime SLAs and the behavior spec. Proposal: Availability SLO = 99.95% for Dedicated lanes; p95 latency target 40ms, p99 160ms for 256-token baseline on c4-like nodes. If queue depth > 75% for 2m, route to cached response or cheaper quantized variant.
maya (reliability): +1 on metrics. Add these alerting rules: page on error_rate > 0.2% sustained 15m OR latency_p95 > 2x target for 10m. Error budget windows: 7d rolling, auto-throttle when burn > 60% in any 1h window. Need a short runbook template with rollback & model-fallback steps.
sam (sales-eng): Sales needs clear tiered throughput commitments and language for refunds/credits if we miss committed throughput. Also want an example clause for Dedicated vs Hosted in the contract. I'll draft suggested contract snippets if product provides tiers.
niya (pricing): I'll sketch buckets: Sandbox (metered), Growth (monthly commit + 20% burst), Reserved (annual commit + deep discount + premium support). Rough unit math to include in docs:
```
// example cost calc (Growth bucket)
base_unit = $0.00035 // per token
commit_discount = 0.18 // 18% off base for commit
effective_unit = base_unit * (1 - commit_discount)
```
Need realistic token mix (short/long) to set commit levels.
ravi (devex): I'll produce quickstarts and the online pricing calculator. Can we standardize a sample SDK snippet for selecting cost profile? I'll add that to examples.
infra-bot: Created issue INF-2401: "dynamic-cost-profiles - runbook + alerting rules" assigned to maya, leo.
maya (reliability): I'll start a runbook draft in the playbooks repo and include PagerDuty escalation steps + who to cc for billing-impact incidents.
leo (eng-runtime): For docs I'll author: SLA appendix, fallback routing flowchart, and compatibility table for quantized variants. Will also add a short section on expected degradation modes.
anya (product): Great — owners confirmed: SLA & runtime = leo+maya; docs & quickstarts = ravi+leo; pricing = niya; contract language = sam. Deliverables: 1) Owner commit and checklist draft by Thu EOD; 2) Runbook skeleton and PD escalation by Mon; 3) Pricing buckets + sample calculator by Fri. Anyone blocked on data?
niya (pricing): Need a per-customer token histogram (0-128,129-512,513+) + 90-day peak usage from sales data. Sam can you pull?
sam (sales-eng): On it — will DM procurement & get anonymized histograms.
anya (product): Perfect. We'll iterate in this thread — please drop short updates here so we have a single decision trail. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
